title: View Current Zone Configuration in the WCS API
summary: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent approved API client to execute GET Get Zone Config and inspect the live zone configuration.
when_to_use: Use the OptiSweep / WCS API to retrieve and inspect the current live zone configuration during configuration verification or troubleshooting.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to change the zone configuration.
Do not use Update Zone Config; the operation is described as no longer used.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Access the OptiSweep / WCS API through Apidog or an equivalent approved API client, execute GET Get Zone Config, and interpret the returned configuration.
Provide technical review or escalation support if the request fails or the current zone configuration is not displayed.

safety_notes: This procedure is read-only and does not include Update Zone Config or another configuration-changing operation.

access_required: L2/L3 access to the OptiSweep / WCS API
Access to Apidog or an equivalent approved API client
system_preconditions: The OptiSweep / WCS API is available to the approved API client.

visual_references.description: OptiSweep / WCS API System API list showing GET Get Zone Config among the available operations.
OptiSweep / WCS API System operations view identifying GetZoneConfig as the operation that shows the current zone configuration and distinguishing UpdateZoneConfig as unused.

steps.title: Open GET Get Zone Config in the OptiSweep / WCS API
steps.purpose: Select the read-only API operation used to retrieve the current zone configuration.
steps.instruction: In Apidog or an equivalent approved API client, open the OptiSweep / WCS API and locate GET Get Zone Config in the System API list.
steps.expected_result: GET Get Zone Config is visible and selected as the API operation to inspect the current zone configuration.
steps.healthy_condition: The OptiSweep / WCS API client displays GET Get Zone Config in the System API list.
steps.failure_condition: GET Get Zone Config is not available or cannot be selected in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.

actions.label: Locate zone configuration request
actions.exact_action: Locate GET Get Zone Config in the System API list.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if GET Get Zone Config is not available or cannot be selected.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OptiSweep provides APIs to get data and to make requests; Apidog is installed on the primary servers; the API list includes GET Get Zone Config.
GetZoneConfig shows the current zone configuration.

steps.title: Execute GET Get Zone Config in the OptiSweep / WCS API
steps.purpose: Request the live zone configuration from the OptiSweep / WCS API.
steps.instruction: With GET Get Zone Config selected in Apidog or the approved OptiSweep / WCS API client, execute GET Get Zone Config.
steps.expected_result: The API client returns a response for GET Get Zone Config.
steps.healthy_condition: GET Get Zone Config executes and returns configuration data in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.
steps.failure_condition: The request fails or does not return configuration data.
stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the GET Get Zone Config request fails.
Do not proceed to any configuration update operation.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: GetZoneConfig shows the current zone configuration; UpdateZoneConfig allows changes but is never used.

steps.title: Review the returned zone configuration
steps.purpose: Confirm that the API response displays the current live zone configuration.
steps.instruction: Review the returned configuration values in the OptiSweep / WCS API client and use them as the current zone configuration for the diagnostic.
steps.expected_result: The GET Get Zone Config response displays the current live zone configuration values.
steps.healthy_condition: Configuration values are displayed in the response from GET Get Zone Config.
steps.failure_condition: The response does not display the current zone configuration values.

actions.label: Inspect returned configuration
actions.exact_action: Review the returned configuration values as the current zone configuration.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the response does not display the current zone configuration.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: GetZoneConfig shows the current zone configuration.

success_criteria: GET Get Zone Config is available in the OptiSweep / WCS API client.
The response displays the current live zone configuration values.
healthy_conditions: Apidog or the approved API client displays GET Get Zone Config in the System API list.
GET Get Zone Config returns a response containing configuration data.
The returned configuration values are visible for inspection.
failure_conditions: GET Get Zone Config is unavailable or cannot be selected.
The GET Get Zone Config request fails.
The response does not display the current zone configuration.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to L3_support if the request fails or the response does not display the current zone configuration.
Do not use Update Zone Config as a workaround; the operation is described as no longer used.
